**Diagnosis: Agent Desktop cannot be implemented as a working capability in this self-update candidate.**

The read-only host context shows no Agent Desktop dispatcher or registered Agent Desktop MCP tool. The MCP adapter in [`/context/checks/workspace_mcp.py`](/context/checks/workspace_mcp.py) registers tools such as `workspace`, `files`, `apps`, and `projects`, but no Agent Desktop tool. The protected Broker in [`/context/ui-workbench/runtime/workspace_broker.py`](/context/ui-workbench/runtime/workspace_broker.py) is the MCP tool-dispatch boundary; it has no Agent Desktop adapter.

Electron preload exposes only the existing UI methods in [`/context/ui-workbench/desktop/preload.cjs`](/context/ui-workbench/desktop/preload.cjs). Its protected main process, [`/context/ui-workbench/desktop/main.cjs`](/context/ui-workbench/desktop/main.cjs), routes a fixed set of IPC operations and has no Agent Desktop host integration.

A trusted host integration would need to add and register the Agent Desktop adapter in the Broker/MCP dispatch path, and expose any required desktop operations through Electron’s main-process IPC and preload boundary. Those host sources are under read-only `/context`, not the editable candidate. No files were changed, and no desktop actions or installations were performed.
